item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena's school has two water tanks on the roof. Tank P is tall and narrow, and the water level in it is 4.0 m above the ground-floor tap. Tank Q is short and wide, holds much more water in total, but the water level in it is only 2.5 m above an identical ground-floor tap.
Both taps are opened fully. Which statement about the water pressure at the taps is correct?

options.A: The tap from tank P has greater pressure, because the height of water above it is greater.
options.B: The tap from tank Q has greater pressure, because tank Q holds more water in total.
options.C: Both taps have equal pressure, because both tanks are on the same roof.
options.D: The tap from tank Q has greater pressure, because a wider tank pushes water out faster.
